summary: TransparentBusiness filed an 8-K regarding swap agreements with Philippine property sellers. Per the agreements, the company will issue 4,242,049,002 Unicoin tokens (UNCN) in exchange for real estate assets valued at approximately $757.8 million. Tokens vest 20% at UNCN's public launch (September 28, 2026) and 5% monthly thereafter. Philippine law requires 60% land ownership by Philippine persons, so an affiliated Philippine entity will hold legal title. Seller identities and asset specifics are redacted as confidential and immaterial. This is a non-standard asset-for-cryptocurrency exchange, not a traditional special situation; it does not fit acquisition, divestiture, or other defined categories.
